question: When will the windows of the Moreau extension be delivered?
expected_answer: The sources disagree. Planning PLN-2026-003 indice A of 17 March 2026 plans the delivery of window order BC-2026-009 on 30 March 2026 (task T07), but VanArsdel Menuiseries' e-mail of 18 March 2026 postpones it to Monday 20 April 2026 (week 17) because of a shortage of aluminium profiles at its supplier, and the minutes of site meeting n°3 (24 March 2026) record the same new date, with installation from 21 to 23 April 2026. Applying the resolution rule (authority, then recency), the latest information prevails: delivery on 20 April 2026, and planning indice A is out of date on this point. VanArsdel Menuiseries' later e-mail of 8 April 2026 (about the doors of the résidence Les Nacrines) confirms the 20 April 2026 delivery of BC-2026-009 again.
notes: Asked by the conducteur de travaux. S4 contradiction (P14), scored on full/ only: once held-back/chantiers/moreau/3-execution/schedule/PLN-2026-003_indice-B_planning-et-suivi-des-achats.xlsx is added (S10 time travel), indice B supersedes indice A and the answer becomes 20 April 2026 alone. Scoped to Moreau since slice F: the school's windows are q029/q030.

question: Which version of quote DEV-2026-014 is the current one, and what is its total including VAT compared with the version it replaced?
expected_answer: Indice B of 3 February 2026 is current: it cancels and replaces indice A of 20 January 2026. On 28 January 2026 the clients asked for a wider sliding bay window F1 (3,00 m instead of 2,40 m) and for floor tiling in the extension (item 7.3, 2040,00 € excluding VAT); the wall and lining areas were adjusted.

expected_answer: The windows are now expected on Monday 20 April 2026 (week 17) instead of 30 March 2026: VanArsdel Menuiseries postponed the delivery because of a shortage of aluminium profiles at its supplier (e-mail of 18 March 2026, confirmed by its e-mail of 8 April 2026). question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?
expected_answer: Not as it stands. Invoice FA-2026-0217 of 16 March 2026 (order BC-2026-012, delivery note BL-2026-0391 of 13 March 2026) bills 10 pallets of hollow concrete blocks ZM-20450 at 79,20 € = 792,00 €, 30 bags of mortar ZM-31020 (237,00 €), 24 steel bars ZM-44108 (226,80 €), one lintel ZM-27340 (164,00 €) and the crane delivery (65,00 €): 1484,80 € excluding VAT, 296,96 € VAT at 20 %, 1781,76 € including VAT, due on 30 April 2026. The scanned delivery note prints 10 pallets as well, but the receiver wrote by hand '2 palettes manquantes' and 'reçu 8 pal.' (received by M. Ancelin): only 8 pallets were received; the other article lines match. Two pallets are billed but not delivered: 2 x 79,20 € = 158,40 € excluding VAT, plus 31,68 € VAT at 20 %, that is 190,08 € including VAT. The purchase tracking shows order BC-2026-012 at 1484,80 € excluding VAT, fully invoiced, and site meeting n°3 asked Bertrand Sauzède to check the invoice against the delivery note before payment, by 31 March 2026. Settle the two missing pallets with Zava Matériaux (delivery or a credit note of 158,40 € excluding VAT) before paying.
notes: skill=check-supplier-invoice; S5: 10 pallets billed, 8 received (handwritten, OCR evidence only); the amount at stake is derived, not printed: 2 x 79,20 € = 158,40 € HT, 190,08 € TTC.

question: Use the prepare-site-meeting skill to prepare site meeting no. 4 of the Moreau chantier on 7 April 2026.
expected_answer: Brief for site meeting no. 4 (7 April 2026, 08:30, on site). Progress: site setup, earthworks, foundations and slab are complete (slab poured on 12 March 2026); the walls were at 70 % on 24 March 2026, against 20 % in planning PLN-2026-003 indice A of 17 March 2026; the roof structure and roofing, with the roof window of amendment n°1, start on 30 March 2026 (task T06). Deliveries: planning indice A still plans the windows of order BC-2026-009 on 30 March 2026 (task T07), but VanArsdel Menuiseries postponed them to 20 April 2026 (e-mail of 18 March 2026), with installation from 21 to 23 April 2026 according to the minutes; the most recent date prevails until the planning is revised. Open actions of meeting n°3: Inès Roux updates planning PLN-2026-003 to indice B (due 27 March 2026); Bertrand Sauzède checks Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 against the delivery note of 13 March 2026 before payment (due 31 March 2026); Damien Pradère confirms the electrical work of 7 April 2026 (due 31 March 2026); the Moreau family empties the kitchen cupboards (due 3 April 2026). Decisions to follow up: temporary closure of the openings with wooden panels on 7 April 2026 (D1), kitchen work brought forward to 7-10 April 2026 (D2), opening of the existing wall moved to 27-29 April 2026 (D3), handover kept on 15 May 2026 (D4). Gaps: the crew schedule of 3 April 2026 staffs week 15 with the temporary closure and then the kitchen, as decided, but no document after 24 March 2026 says whether the actions of meeting n°3 were done.
notes: skill=prepare-site-meeting; S4: planning indice A (windows on 2026-03-30, walls at 20 % on 2026-03-17) is out of date; the four actions of meeting n°3 have no later follow-up in the corpus.

question: Use the track-contract-amounts skill: what does the Moreau job cost in total after amendments, what has been paid so far and what remains to be paid?
expected_answer: Works contract of 10 February 2026 at the price of quote DEV-2026-014 indice B: 37843,00 € excluding VAT, 44943,60 € including VAT. Amendment n°1 of 10 March 2026: 1940,00 € excluding VAT, 388,00 € VAT, 2328,00 € including VAT, payable at handover, the 5 % retention applying to it as well. New total: 39783,00 € excluding VAT, 47271,60 € including VAT. Payment schedule of the contract (amounts including VAT): 30 % deposit 13483,08 € at signature; 30 % 13483,08 € at the end of the masonry (slab and walls); 25 % 11235,90 € when the extension is weathertight; 10 % 4494,36 € at handover; 5 % retention 2247,18 € released one year after handover if no reserves remain open. Paid so far: the deposit of 13483,08 €, paid at signature on 10 February 2026; no later payment appears in the documents. Still to pay: 47271,60 - 13483,08 = 33788,52 € including VAT, that is the three remaining instalments, the retention and the 2328,00 € of the amendment at handover; 5 % of the amendment (116,40 €) is held back with the retention, so 2363,58 € in total is released one year after handover.
notes: skill=track-contract-amounts; S2 and S3; derived, not printed: 33788,52 € TTC still to pay, 116,40 € retention on the amendment, 2363,58 € retention in total.

question: VanArsdel Menuiseries reports a shortage of aluminium profiles: which chantiers does it hit, and which réception dates are at risk?
expected_answer: Two chantiers are hit, the school is not so far. Moreau: the windows of order BC-2026-009 were postponed from 30 March 2026 to Monday 20 April 2026 (e-mail of 18 March 2026), a date VanArsdel Menuiseries confirmed again on 8 April 2026; site meeting n°3 kept the réception on 15 May 2026 (decision D4), so it holds as long as the 20 April delivery holds. Résidence Les Nacrines: the shortage goes on and the two aluminium hall doors of order BC-2026-005 are postponed from 15 April 2026 to Monday 18 May 2026 (week 21, e-mail of 8 April 2026). The réception was already pronounced with réserves on 3 April 2026, and the missing doors are réserve R06, still open on 14 April 2026: with the 30-day lifting delay written on the procès-verbal (3 May 2026, derived), R06 cannot be lifted in time. École du Bourg, Montferrine: the 16 windows of order BC-2026-021 are due on 6 July 2026 and the réception is planned on 28 August 2026; VanArsdel Menuiseries says deliveries from 1 July 2026 are not concerned so far, so the school is not affected yet.
notes: Asked by the gérant. S12 (P13, P32 to P38): Moreau and Les Nacrines are hit; the school is not affected so far. The 30-day lifting delay is handwritten on the scanned procès-verbal (OCR only); its deadline 2026-05-03 is derived, not printed.

question: Does Zava Matériaux invoice Lamna Bâtiment at the prices of the 2026 framework contract? Give the gaps by chantier.
expected_answer: Not always. The framework contract of 8 January 2026 applies the net prices of the annexed tarif 2026 to every order, whatever the chantier, and any line billed above the net price gives a credit note (avoir) for the difference. Moreau, invoice FA-2026-0217 of 16 March 2026: the blocks ZM-20450 are billed 79,20 € per pallet against a net price of 76,80 € (public price 84,50 €), 2,40 € too much on 10 pallets, that is 24,00 € excluding VAT; the other lines (mortar 7,90 €, steel bars 9,45 €, lintel 164,00 €, crane delivery 65,00 €) match the tarif. Résidence Les Nacrines, invoice FA-2026-0158 of 12 February 2026: the glass-fibre mesh ZM-52730 is billed 79,00 € per roll, the public price, against a net price of 68,00 €, 11,00 € too much on 10 rolls, that is 110,00 € excluding VAT; the other lines match. School of Montferrine: no Zava Matériaux invoice yet. Credit notes due: 24,00 € and 110,00 € excluding VAT, 134,00 € in total (derived).
notes: Asked by the gérant. S13 (P40, P41): one gap per invoice; the gaps (24,00 € and 110,00 € HT, 134,00 € in total) are derived, not printed.

question: Zava Matériaux nous facture-t-il aux prix du contrat-cadre 2026 ? Quels sont les écarts, chantier par chantier ?

Le contrat-cadre du 08/01/2026 applique les prix nets du tarif 2026 annexé à chaque commande, quel que soit le chantier, et toute ligne facturée au-dessus du prix net donne lieu à un avoir du montant de l'écart. Moreau, facture FA-2026-0217 du 16/03/2026 : les blocs ZM-20450 sont facturés 79,20 € la palette pour un prix net de 76,80 € (prix public 84,50 €), soit 2,40 € de trop sur 10 palettes : 24,00 € HT ; les autres lignes sont au prix net. Résidence Les Nacrines, facture FA-2026-0158 du 12/02/2026 : le treillis ZM-52730 est facturé 79,00 € le rouleau, le prix public, pour un prix net de 68,00 €, soit 11,00 € de trop sur 10 rouleaux : 110,00 € HT ; les autres lignes sont au prix net. École de Montferrine : aucune facture de Zava Matériaux à ce jour. Avoirs à demander : 24,00 € et 110,00 € HT, 134,00 € HT au total (valeur calculée).
notes: Asked by the gérant, in French; French twin of q019 (S13).

question: At the résidence Les Nacrines, which réserves are still open, and when can the retention guarantee be released?
expected_answer: The réception was pronounced with réserves on 3 April 2026 (scanned procès-verbal, with réserve R07 and a 30-day lifting delay added by hand). On the réserves list of 14 April 2026, four réserves are lifted (R01, R03, R04 and R05) and three are still open: R02, the crack on the repaired balcony nose (OS n°1), work planned on 17 April 2026; R06, the aluminium hall doors not installed, whose delivery by VanArsdel Menuiseries is postponed to 18 May 2026; R07, paint traces on the tiles of hall A, cleaning planned on 16 April 2026. The retention guarantee is 5 % of the price including VAT of each situation: 9620,05 € has been retained to date (situations n°1 to n°4). It is released one year after the réception, on 3 April 2027 (derived), unless the maître d'ouvrage notifies a reasoned opposition for réserves not lifted; it can be replaced by a bank guarantee. expected_answer: La réception a été prononcée avec réserves le 03/04/2026 (procès-verbal scanné, réserve R07 et délai de levée de 30 jours ajoutés à la main).
